description.html: HabiStat Pure Calcium is pure natural calcium carbonate with ultra-fine granules, with particles smaller than 300 microns. This extremely fine grain lets the calcium spread evenly over insects when dusting, ensuring your reptiles get an optimal dose of calcium with every meal. The supplement is enriched with vitamins A, D3 and E in low, safe doses that support proper calcium metabolism without the risk of overdose.

This product is intended for all reptile and amphibian species. It is used by dusting - put the insects in a container, sprinkle them with calcium and shake gently before offering them to your animals. This way, every insect carries a thin layer of calcium that is naturally taken in during feeding. For optimal results, adequate UVB lighting in the terrarium is essential, because vitamin D3, which is key to calcium absorption, forms in reptile skin under UVB rays.

Regular use of a calcium supplement is essential for preventing metabolic bone disease, a condition that is very common in captive reptiles. Without enough calcium, bones become soft and brittle, which can lead to deformities and serious health problems. HabiStat Pure Calcium offers a simple, effective solution for daily supplementation.
